constitutional_basis: Article LII — the killer experiment is a falsification contract; there must exist an experimental outcome that kills the mechanism. Article XX — problem existence precedes mechanism optimization.
question: What is the cheapest credible way to learn whether this technology deserves more money?
hypothesis: A dual-lumen catheter with a low-conductance floor lumen maintains a clinically meaningful minimum drainage rate through the floor lumen alone when the primary lumen is fully obstructed, at physiological pressure head, without common-cause obstruction by the same occluding material.
null_hypothesis: When the primary lumen is obstructed, the floor lumen either (a) carries no clinically meaningful minimum flow (below the to-be-established Q_min), or (b) is obstructed by the same material/mechanism (common-cause failure), making the safety floor indistinguishable from a single-lumen catheter under the same conditions.
control: Standard single-lumen distal CSF shunt catheter of the same material, outer diameter and length (the clinical baseline), tested in the identical bench loop under identical pressure heads and obstruction protocol. The baseline stays UNCHANGED across both arms (Constitution Art. XLVII: identical instrument, identical conditions).
treatment: Extruded dual-lumen sample per the frozen parametric design (primary 1.1 mm + floor 0.6 mm, 3.0 mm OD) — the same instrument measures both arms.
apparatus: Benchtop hydrostatic/column flow loop: constant-pressure reservoir (physiological pressure heads spanning 10-40 mmHg per the P-24 sibling protocol style), water or CSF-mimic fluid at 37 C (viscosity class of the R390 NIST-anchored value, with CSF-vs-water viscosity residual disclosed), in-line flow measurement (gravimetric or calibrated flowmeter), and a controlled primary-lumen obstruction fixture (simulant occlusion: proteinaceous debris analog and tissue-ingrowth analog, the two dominant clinical obstruction classes).
inputs: Two catheter arms (control single-lumen; treatment dual-lumen, n per sample-size basis); obstruction simulants; pressure-head set; fluid at controlled temperature.
outputs: Per arm per condition: steady-state flow rate (mL/hr) vs pressure head before obstruction; residual floor-lumen flow after complete primary obstruction; time-to-zero-flow; observation of whether the simulant also obstructs the floor lumen (common-cause outcome).
measurement_method: Direct flow measurement (gravimetric or calibrated meter) at steady state; ≥3 repetitions per condition; blinded analysis of recorded traces; obstruction verified endoscopically/visually post-test.
baseline: The control arm's flow after identical obstruction (expected: ~zero residual flow — a fully obstructed single-lumen catheter drains nothing; this is the anchor the treatment must beat).
primary_endpoint: Residual drainage through the floor lumen after complete primary-lumen obstruction, expressed against the minimum-flow threshold that the clinical literature review establishes as the safety-relevant Q_min (Q_min itself is a recorded UNKNOWN — the pre-registered clinical-literature derivation of Q_min is PART of this experiment's protocol, owner-gated, not invented here).
secondary_endpoints: Common-cause obstruction rate: fraction of trials where the same simulant obstructs the floor lumen
G_floor/G_primary measured vs the MODELLED (d_floor/d_primary)^4 relation (Poiseuille validity at these Reynolds numbers)
Manufacturability observation of the extruded sample (multi-lumen extrusion process capability is a recorded UNKNOWN)
acceptance_threshold: ACCEPT only if: residual floor flow ≥ the literature-derived Q_min at ≥2 of the physiological pressure heads AND common-cause obstruction rate below the pre-registered limit AND measured G ratio within the pre-registered band of the modelled relation. The Q_min and band values MUST be pre-registered from the clinical literature BEFORE the run (threshold provenance per Constitution Art. XXVII — BUYER_DEFINED/CLINICAL class, never Model_derived silently promoted).
falsifier: KILL the mechanism if: (a) the dominant obstruction simulants obstruct both lumens (common-cause failure of the safety-floor concept — this is the package's own recorded critical kill condition), or (b) residual floor flow is below any clinically defensible Q_min at all pressure heads (the safety floor provides no meaningful protection), or (c) the extrusion cannot produce a sample that passes the min-wall constraint at all (manufacturing impossibility — an Art. XXIX invariant-class failure only if proven for the whole design space, not one sample).
uncertainty: Obstruction simulants are analogs, not ex-vivo human tissue (transfer risk recorded); water-vs-CSF viscosity residual (NIST 310.15 K water 0.6913 mPa·s is the anchored constant; CSF slightly higher — the R390 record's own caveat); Q_min derivation depends on the quality of the clinical literature review; bench loop excludes biological fouling timelines (chronic in-vivo obstruction differs from acute simulant occlusion).
sample_size_basis: Minimum credible: 3 samples per arm × 2 simulant classes × 3 pressure heads with ≥3 repetitions — sized to detect qualitative mechanism failure (residual flow vs none), not to power a clinical effect size. A statistically powered sizing requires the Q_min literature derivation and is owner-gated.
cost_basis: UNESTIMATED for this package — owner input required. Context, not an estimate: the P-24 sibling package recorded $15K / 8 weeks for a comparable bench loop (mock CSF loop, 3 arms × 4 pressures × 10 runs, blinded analysis) — recorded in PORTFOLIO_COMMERCIAL_STATE.json / R339 buyer package.
time_basis: UNESTIMATED — owner input required (comparable sibling protocol class: ~8 weeks including samples and blinded analysis).
safety_constraints: No human/animal subjects (in-vitro bench only); biohazard handling only if ex-vivo material is later added (not in this minimal protocol); no implantation.
decision_rule: ACCEPT -> package advances to SPONSORED_VALIDATION with the physical-validation record attached (first PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION class evidence, real-loop-eligible per Art. XXXVII/XXXVIII through the reality-boundary interface). KILL -> mechanism cemetery entry with the kill class (common-cause / no-residual-flow / manufacturing-invariant) and the lesson codified (Constitution Art. LI). INDETERMINATE (simulant-only positive, Q_min unresolvable) -> recorded as INDETERMINATE, never promoted (Art. XLII discipline applied to experiments).
prior_state: No decisive experiment contract existed at this schema level for P04; the frozen dossier carries planned verification items V-001..V-004 (NOT_TESTED) and the buyer decision card's kill question. This contract is the versioned addition; nothing prior was rewritten.
